component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.capture.providers
component.documentation: The two providers. standin, for development and demonstration servers: deterministic, it reads the file's own text and nothing else, and calls nothing. ai, the AI package's: it calls the package's AI.* operations in the server's process, and is unused until the server both names it in nuxeo.agentic.capture.provider and sets nuxeo.agentic.capture.ai.enabled to true, which is to be done only once the AI data terms are approved (README, "Before the AI provider is switched on").
